redRegression.scenario: Attempt B takes over the job and activates its asset; stale attempt A then invokes the same finalizer.
redRegression.observedBeforeFix: The stale A finalizer resolved successfully and could replace the active playback route after B had finalized.

change.repository: reportProgress, markSucceeded, markFailedOrRetry, markCancelled and release now compare job ID, worker ID, RUNNING state and attemptId. The attempt ID prevents a stale process with the same stable worker ID from mutating the replacement claim.
change.finalization: Route activation locks the VideoEncodeJob row in the same transaction, verifies current ownership, and refreshes heartbeat before changing active routes/assets. A stale claim is rejected; a concurrent stale sweep must wait and then fails its heartbeat compare-and-set.
change.recovery: findExisting searches an active legacy key or any attempt prefix for this unique output generation, so a retry can adopt a route committed just before its previous owner lost the lease.
change.cleanup: A failed stale finalization deletes only its own attempt asset/prefix; it does not delete or overwrite the replacement attempt output.

postgres.command: DATABASE_URL=<disposable-local-PostgreSQL-17> DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=<same> npx prisma migrate deploy && npx vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts tests/postgres/encode-attempt-fencing.pg.test.ts tests/postgres/encode-job.repository.pg.test.ts --reporter=json
postgres.scenario: B takes ownership and finalizes; stale A is rejected, B remains RUNNING/current and active, only B's asset remains; same-worker-ID stale writes are rejected across repository mutations.
postgres.environment: Disposable postgres:17-alpine container removed after run; no external storage.

limits: The takeover interleaving used real PostgreSQL and production routes/repositories, but was sequenced in one integration test rather than two independently running worker processes.
No Cloudflare R2/S3 sandbox, full product build, controlled worker drain or independent review was performed.
K18 still must examine post-COMMIT audit/finalizer effects; K17 does not close R02 or the full encoder release gate.
